CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFINPUT

CFINPUT writes an HTML INPUT control inside a CFFORM and registers validation rules for it: required entry, a data type such as a date or a phone number, a numeric range, or your own JavaScript function.

Category

Forms

Syntax

<CFINPUT TYPE="input_type"
    NAME="name"
    VALUE="initial_value"
    REQUIRED="Yes/No"
    VALIDATE="data_type"
    RANGE="min_value,max_value"
    ONVALIDATE="javascript_function"
    MESSAGE="validation_message"
    ONERROR="javascript_function"
    SIZE="integer"
    MAXLENGTH="integer"
    CHECKED="Yes/No"
    PASSTHROUGH="HTML_attributes">

Attributes

TYPE
Optional, default "Text". Text, Password, Radio or Checkbox.
NAME
Required. Name of the form field.
VALUE
Optional. Initial value (Text, Password) or the value sent when checked (Radio, Checkbox).
REQUIRED
Optional, default "No". Yes: the field must not be empty; for radio buttons and check boxes, one of the group must be checked.
VALIDATE
Optional. Data type to check: date (mm/dd/yyyy), eurodate (dd/mm/yyyy), time (hh:mm or hh:mm:ss), float, integer, telephone (###-###-####), zipcode (##### or #####-####), creditcard (13 to 16 digits with a valid check digit) or social_security_number (###-##-####). Empty fields pass unless REQUIRED is set.
RANGE
Optional. Minimum and maximum numeric value, as "min,max". Either may be left out: "0," or ",100".
ONVALIDATE
Optional. Name of your own JavaScript function, called as fn(form, field, value). Return true if the value is acceptable.
MESSAGE
Optional. Text of the alert shown when a check fails. The default is "Error in fieldname text."
ONERROR
Optional. Custom error routine. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always uses the standard alert.
SIZE
Optional. Width of the field in characters.
MAXLENGTH
Optional. Maximum number of characters accepted.
CHECKED
Optional, default "No". Yes pre-selects a radio button or check box.
PASSTHROUGH
Optional. Extra HTML attributes copied into the INPUT tag as they are.

Usage

Each rule becomes a test in the JavaScript function that CFFORM generates; the rules are checked in the order the controls appear, and the first failure stops the submission. All checks happen in the browser; repeat any check that matters (a credit card, say) in the action page.

The telephone check accepts the common US spellings "617-555-1212", "(617) 555-1212" and "6175551212". Two-digit years in dates are read as 19xx for 30-99 and 20xx for 00-29, so your forms will cope with the year 2000.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFIF IsDefined("Form.FieldNames")>
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <P><B>Order received:</B> #Form.Quantity# x #Form.Color# case,
  ship #Form.ShipDate# to ZIP #Form.Zip#, phone #Form.Phone#,
  <CFIF IsDefined("Form.GiftWrap")>gift wrapped.<CFELSE>no gift wrap.</CFIF>
  </CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>

<CFFORM NAME="Order" ACTION="cfinput.cfm">
<TABLE>
<TR><TD>Quantity:</TD><TD><CFINPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Quantity" VALUE="1" SIZE="3"
    VALIDATE="integer" RANGE="1,99" REQUIRED="Yes"
    MESSAGE="Order between 1 and 99 cases."></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Case color:</TD><TD>
    <CFINPUT TYPE="Radio" NAME="Color" VALUE="Beige" CHECKED="Yes"> Beige
    <CFINPUT TYPE="Radio" NAME="Color" VALUE="Translucent blue"> Translucent blue</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Ship on:</TD><TD><CFINPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="ShipDate" SIZE="10" VALIDATE="date"
    VALUE="#DateFormat(DateAdd('d', 7, Now()), 'mm/dd/yyyy')#"
    MESSAGE="Enter the date as mm/dd/yyyy."></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>ZIP code:</TD><TD><CFINPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Zip" SIZE="10" VALIDATE="zipcode"
    REQUIRED="Yes" MESSAGE="A US ZIP code, like 02139."></TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Phone:</TD><TD><CFINPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Phone" SIZE="14"
    VALIDATE="telephone" MESSAGE="A phone number like 617-555-1212."></TD></TR>
<TR><TD></TD><TD><CFINPUT TYPE="Checkbox" NAME="GiftWrap" VALUE="Yes"> Gift wrap</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
<INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Place order">
</CFFORM>
